summary: The PR description states the five new denominator declarations were ported from the AINTLIB HasseWeil project (`HasseWeil/Auxiliary/EllipticDivisibilitySequence.lean` at `dev/hasse-weil @ 513e83879e2f`), but the file's Provenance section credits a different project, file and revision (`LutzNagell/EllipticDivisibilitySequence.lean` at `main @ 1c1c7466…`) and never mentions HasseWeil. The two credits are incompatible; the PR must state which source it actually drew on.
